records.jp: 影さーん
records.en_original: Shadooow?
records.en: Shadooow?

records.jp: おかえりなさい
records.en_original: Welcome back.
records.en: Welcome back.

records.jp: さあ、台座に宝珠を
records.en_original: Now, place the orb on the pedestal.
records.en: Now, place the orb on the pedestal.

records.jp: わあ……！
records.en_original: Wow...!
records.en: Wow...!

records.jp: 晴れたわね
records.en_original: It cleared up.
records.en: It cleared up.

records.jp: ……あの、一つ聞きたいんだけど
records.en_original: Um, can we ask you something?
records.en: Um, can we ask you something?

records.jp: 私？
records.en_original: Me?
records.en: Me?

records.jp: 「悪い想い」ってどういうものなの？<CR>私たち、よく分かってなくて……
records.en_original: What did you mean by negative emotions? We don't really understand.
records.en: What exactly are these "negative feelings"?<CR>We do not really understand them...

records.jp: 敵を知り己を知れば百戦殆うからず。<CR>立ち向かうためにも情報は必要
records.en_original: If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles. We require more information.
records.en: Know the enemy and know yourself, and you need not fear a hundred battles.<CR>We need information if we are going to face them.

records.jp: 私たちは、私たちの愛した日常を取り戻すために<CR>とても大きなことを成し遂げなければならない
records.en_original: We all decided to do something great in order to get back the world you all loved.
records.en: We have to accomplish something enormous<CR>to regain the everyday lives we loved.

records.jp: そう思ったとき、みんなの心の中に<CR>一つの疑念が生まれた
records.en_original: But when you did, a doubt was birthed in everyone's hearts.
records.en: When we resolved to do that,<CR>a single doubt arose in everyone's hearts.

records.jp: そんなこと、本当にできるのか？
records.en_original: Is this really possible?
records.en: Is this really possible?

records.jp: 私たちに成し遂げられる量を越えているんじゃないか
records.en_original: Is this too much for us?
records.en: Isn't it more than we can accomplish?

records.jp: ただ自由に過ごしたいだけなのに、<CR>目の前に成し遂げなければいけない大きな課題がある
records.en_original: All I want to do is live in peace, why me?
records.en: All we want is to live freely,<CR>but there is this enormous task before us that we have to accomplish.

records.jp: まるで……終わらない夏休みの宿題を出されたみたいに
records.en_original: Like a big assignment to end your endless summer vacation.
records.en: Like... being given summer homework that never ends.

records.jp: 夏休みの宿題……
records.en_original: An assignment...
records.en: An assignment...

records.jp: あなたたちが相手をした影たちは、<CR>そんな夏休みの宿題に反抗する想いたち
records.en_original: The shadows are the part of you that are rebelling against this reality.
records.en: The shadows you faced are the feelings<CR>rebelling against that endless summer homework.

records.jp: 遊びに逃げようとする、怠惰な想いの集積……
records.en_original: Accumulations of your desires to play and run from responsibility.
records.en: An accumulation of lazy feelings trying to escape into play...

records.jp: 宿題は終わらせなければならない
records.en_original: But this assignment must be finished.
records.en: But this assignment must be finished.

records.jp: 誰がやらずとも、私だけは続けなくちゃいけない。<CR>学校を守るために。皆の日常を取り戻すために……
records.en_original: Even if no one wants to, I must continue. To protect the school, and to give us our lives back.
records.en: Even if no one else will, I must keep going.<CR>To protect the school. To restore everyone's everyday lives...

records.jp: そう言われると、なるほどなぁ……って感じだけど
records.en_original: That does make a lot of sense.
records.en: That does make a lot of sense.

records.jp: 遊びたい気持ちと、頑張らなくちゃいけない気持ちが<CR>ぶつかった結果がこの島だった、ということですね
records.en_original: So our conflicting desires to enjoy ourselves and our feelings of responsibility created this island.
records.en: So this island was created by the clash between<CR>our desire to play and our feeling that we have to keep trying.

records.jp: 葛藤、か……
records.en_original: That’s what you meant by conflict...
records.en: That’s what you meant by conflict...

records.jp: じゃああなたは、ずっと一人で頑張って<CR>宿題をやろうとしてくれてたんだね
records.en_original: So you've been trying all this time to finish that assignment.
records.en: So you've been working all alone this whole time<CR>to finish the homework for us.

records.jp: ――残る宝珠はあと一つ。<CR>歩み進めることだけが、唯一の正解
records.en_original: One orb remains. Sometimes moving forward is our only choice.
records.en: Only one orb remains.<CR>The only correct answer is to keep moving forward.

records.jp: ……あの子が言いたいことも分かるけどね
records.en_original: What she's saying does make sense.
records.en: What she's saying does make sense.

records.jp: そうだね。間違ったことを言ってるわけじゃない
records.en_original: Yes. She's not wrong.
records.en: Yes. She's not wrong.

records.jp: どうしよう……？
records.en_original: Now what...?
records.en: Now what...?

records.jp: 唯一の正解、か……
records.en_original: Our only choice...
records.en: Our only choice...

records.jp: 片方の言い分を聞いたなら、<CR>もう片方の話も聞くべきなんじゃない？
records.en_original: Now that we've talked with her, shouldn't we hear what the other side has to say?
records.en: Now that we've heard one side,<CR>shouldn't we hear the other side too?

records.jp: それもそうか
records.en_original: I suppose you're right.
records.en: I suppose you're right.

records.jp: 最後の影に話を聞いてみよう。<CR>何が正解かは、私たちが決める
records.en_original: Let's try and talk with the last shadow. Then we can decide what to do.
records.en: Let's ask the final shadow what she thinks.<CR>We will decide what the right answer is.
